What you need at the top is learned at the bottom.

Kevin Trudeau quotes John D. Rockefeller: only by enduring what others cannot bear can you do what others cannot do.

A great multimillionaire said everything he knew at the top, he learned at the bottom. Kevin asks you to see adversity as a chance to learn, grow and find something you hadn't thought of before.

What has your hardest time taught you?
